rationale.scope: Every value here only produces a note in the log and the flight recorder. Nothing refuses, delays or stops a job: Pietro removed all native host guards on 2026-11-22. Readings were taken on the Intel i5-8259U build host (8 logical CPUs, 8 GiB) between 21:48 BRT on 2026-11-19 and 00:47 BRT on 2026-11-20.
rationale.warn_load_percent_of_cpus: 6.00 on 8 CPUs: the 1-minute load average read 2.42-4.96 without a native build and 6.11-14 with overlapping loads.
rationale.warn_swap_used_mib: macOS keeps swap allocated after the pressure that filled it has ended, so the value records history: it read 190-696 MiB without a native build, 1016-1551 MiB during one serial iOS build, and 1193 MiB on an idle host with normal memory pressure. 1600 is above every reading.
rationale.warn_compressor_percent_of_memory: vm.compressor_bytes_used read 368-1807 MiB (4-22% of 8 GiB), and memory pressure was normal at both ends of that range. 25 is above every reading.
rationale.child_niceness: Judgment call. Its effect was not measured.
